camel_example: aliyun iot CreateJob --region cn-hangzhou --Type INVOKE_SERVICE --JobDocument 'serviceIdentifier_:_test_service_,_params_:_key1_:_value1_,_key2_:_value2' --JobName oneJob --TargetConfig '{"key":"example-string"}'
description_zh: 调用该接口创建设备任务
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-job --job-document serviceIdentifier_:_test_service_,_params_:_key1_:_value1_,_key2_:_value2 --type INVOKE_SERVICE --job-name oneJob --target-config '{"key":"example-string"}' --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateJob

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the job. The description can be up to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务的描述信息。长度不超过100个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The job execution rule file to be sent to devices. The data is in JSON format and can be up to 65,536 characters in length.

For more information, see the "JobDocument definition" section below
parameters.help_zh:
下发给设备的任务执行规则文件。数据格式为JSON，长度不超过65536个字符。

更多信息，请参见下文“JobDocument定义”
parameters.name: job_document

parameters.help_en:
The job type. Valid values:
INVOKE_SERVICE: a batch service invocation job for devices.
SET_PROPERTY: a batch property setting job for devices.
PUB: a batch Pub message push job.
CUSTOM_JOB: a custom job
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型。取值：
INVOKE_SERVICE：设备批量服务调用任务。
SET_PROPERTY：设备批量属性设置任务。
PUB：Pub批量消息推送任务。
CUSTOM_JOB：自定义任务
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The file to be sent to devices in a custom job.

This parameter is valid only when Type is set to CUSTOM_JOB, and it is optional.

For more information, see the "JobFile definition" section below
parameters.help_zh:
自定义任务中下发给设备的文件。

仅Type为CUSTOM_JOB时，可传入此参数，且为非必传参数。

更多信息，请参见下文“JobFile定义”
parameters.name: job_file

parameters.help_en: The job name. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 4 to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称。支持中文、英文字母、数字和下划线（_），长度范围为4~30个字符
parameters.name: job_name

parameters.help_en:
The timeout configuration for task execution within the job. The data is in JSON format and can be up to 8,192 characters in length.

For more information, see the "TimeoutConfig definition" section below
parameters.help_zh:
任务下作业执行的超时配置，数据格式为JSON，长度不超过8192个字符。

更多信息，请参见下文“TimeoutConfig定义”
parameters.name: timeout_config

parameters.help_en:
The rollout rate configuration for task pushing within the job. The data is in JSON format and can be up to 8,192 characters in length.

For more information, see the "RolloutConfig definition" section below
parameters.help_zh:
任务下作业推送速率配置，数据格式为JSON，长度不超过8192个字符。

更多信息，请参见下文“RolloutConfig定义”
parameters.name: rollout_config

parameters.help_en:
The target device configuration for the device job.

For more information, see the "TargetConfig" section below
parameters.help_zh:
设备任务的目标设备配置。

更多信息，请参见下文“TargetConfig”
parameters.name: target_config

parameters.help_en:
The scheduled time of the job in milliseconds. Valid values: 10 minutes to 7 days from the current time.

If this parameter is not specified, the job is initialized and scheduled for execution immediately after creation.
If this parameter is specified, the job is initialized after creation and scheduled for execution only after the specified time
parameters.help_zh:
任务调度时间的毫秒数。取值范围：当前时间的10分钟后到7天之间。

不传入此参数：任务创建后，立即初始化并调度执行。
传入此参数：任务创建后，先初始化，等到设置的调度时间后，才开始调度执行。
parameters.name: scheduled_time

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

JobId.description_en: The job ID. This is the globally unique identifier of the job
JobId.description_zh: 任务ID。任务的全局唯一标识符

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
